title: McKinsey AI Value Curve: $2.52T at Risk From Costs
script:
Eight hundred fifty billion dollars is now at risk from rising AI costs.
McKinsey analysts identified this figure as the potential impact of a thirty percent cost increase.
This calculation stems from an annual global economic value projection of two point five two trillion dollars.
The value curve measures how AI might shift productivity across global sectors.
Rising operational expenses threaten to erode those gains for companies scaling models.
Most organizations still struggle to convert these technical capabilities into bottom line growth.
Investors are watching whether these high costs will eventually yield the promised efficiency.
Is your business seeing real returns on AI spending?
